verse.name: v1
verse.lines:
YESU-amanyi bwe mbeera
N'ebirowoozo byonna
N'obunafu bwange-era,
Byonna ye abimanyi.

verse.name: v2
verse.lines:
Ng'omuzadde w'omwana
Bw'asaasira-omwana we,
Yesu bw'asaasira nze
Mu-ebyo byonna bye nkola.

verse.name: v3
verse.lines:
Yesu fenna-atwagala
Abakulu n'abato;
Anaatusonyiwanga
Bwe tuba twenenyezza.

verse.name: v4
verse.lines:
Weenenye ggwe-omwonoonyi
Ye anaakusonyiwa;
Omusembeze gy'oli
Mwenenyereze ddala.

verse.name: v5
verse.lines:
Ojja kulokolebwa
Mu bibi byo-ebyo byonna;
Teweeraliikirira,
Ali kumpi nnyo naawe.
